verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console. Before provisioning, it lets you compare placement availability across Zones for one or more GPU and CPU instance types and a requested Node count, which directly addresses checking availability by type and location rather than discovering stockouts by failure. Quota viewing in the console adds pre-provisioning visibility. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that availability data is real-time, evidence that Capacity Finder applies beyond the Spot Node Pool workflow, programmatic/API access to availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
